fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2026-02-27, around 12:25, a neighbour allegedly obstructed access and used abusive language towards the complainant near Roja Park Main Street on repeated occasions, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-03-04. Padmini Rani approached Coimbatore North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000028. Nithya Rani (9000000035) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A further person, Babu Balan, a co-worker, using the number 9000000231, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Kishore Arumugam, associated with the number 9000000189, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00235, as the mobile number 9000000189 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Access to the property reportedly obstructed repeatedly.
